facts.fact: Sandy 的父母把当女巫当成又一个青春期阶段，靠疏离的容忍等着它自己过去
facts.anchor: being a witch was yet another teenage phase like being vegetarian or being nonbinary

facts.fact: Sandy 不是只爱黑色美学的哥特，而是每天以召唤灵体开场、以小五芒星仪式收尾的修行型 hedge witch
facts.anchor: Sandy was a practicing hedge witch who started each day with an invocation to the spirits

facts.fact: 巫术给 Sandy 在混乱世界里的一点掌控与信念，最重要的是一件武器：人们怕巫师
facts.anchor: But, most important of all, it gave them a weapon

facts.fact: Sandy 当着 Mr. Williams 的面说以魔鬼之名诅咒他，对方还发起要让 Sandy 停学的运动
facts.anchor: campaigned to get Sandy suspended, so Sandy looked that old shitbag in the face and said

facts.fact: Sandy 带上岛的法器有限：一只掌心钴蓝邪眼的青铜 Hamsa、一只对自己有个人意义的迷你塑料兔头骨和几根蜡烛
facts.anchor: one a bronze Hamsa with a cobalt-blue evil eye in its palm, the other a miniature plastic rabbit skull

facts.fact: Sandy 从魔法书读到中世纪信念：每只兔子生来都是雌雄完美合一，因此把兔子视为与本我认同的形象
facts.anchor: every rabbit was born a perfect union of both male and female

facts.fact: 睡前 Sandy 点蜡烛低声念祷词保佑夜里健康，捏灭烛芯后房间陷入黑暗
facts.anchor: Sandy did a quick ritual, burning a candle and mumbling a prayer to preserve their health during the night

facts.fact: 睡眠瘫痪的重压下，Sandy 用几乎听不见的耳语念出变兔咒文
facts.anchor: With sighing and sorrow and meckle care, I go forth in the form of a hare

facts.fact: 野兔毫不费力地穿过上了锈锁的天花板舱门，登上 widow's walk，夜里空气凉而潮
facts.anchor: It passed through solid matter without a thought. The night air beyond was cool and damp

facts.fact: 地下安息日人群中央坐着魔鬼，庞大多毛、黑暗里只辨出长长的拖鞋般耳朵与灯般的凝视之眼
facts.anchor: except for the long, long, slipper-like ears and staring, lamp-like eyes
